"""Continue bounded verification after fully retained streaming and file-hash pass.
No archives or old restore trees are reread. No application tests run.
"""
import datetime,hashlib,json,pathlib,resource,runpy,sys,time,traceback
P=pathlib.Path;C=P(__file__).resolve().parent;start=time.monotonic()
def load(p):return json.loads(P(p).read_text())
def write(p,v):P(p).write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
code=0
for n in ['INDEPENDENT-FINAL-RECOVERY-VERIFICATION.json','INDEPENDENT-FINAL-RESEARCH-VERIFICATION.json','independent-final-verification.log','independent-final-verification.resources.json','independent_final_verifier.py']:
    p=C/(n+'.attempt2')
    if not p.exists():p.write_bytes((C/n).read_bytes())
prior=load(C/'INDEPENDENT-FINAL-RECOVERY-VERIFICATION.json.attempt2');metrics=load(C/'independent-final-verification.resources.json.attempt2')
assert prior['result']=='BLOCKED' and prior['blocker']['message']=='QA live membership differs'
assert prior['allArchivesAndMembersRehashed'] and prior['allRestoredFilesRehashed'] and prior['restoredMembershipExact'] and prior['source']['currentAndSnapshotBytesVerified']
assert prior['counts']['restoredFiles']==5948 and prior['counts']['archiveMemberOccurrences']==6011
script=C/'independent_final_verifier.py';ns=runpy.run_path(str(script));REC=prior.copy();REC.pop('blocker');REC['result']='IN_PROGRESS';RES={'result':'IN_PROGRESS','startedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()};ns.update({'REC':REC,'RES':RES})
try:
    tree=load(C/'VERIFIED-CHERY-TREE.json');sc=load(C/'source-capture.json');sp=load(C/'source-package.json');qs=load(C/'qa-delta-result.json');qm=load(qs['manifest']);rs=load(C/'chery-snapshot-result.json');rm=load(rs['manifest'])
    mapping=ns['map_records'];wanted=mapping(tree['files']);source=mapping(sc['files'],'roadmark/');qa=mapping(qm['fullCurrentFileManifest']);research=mapping(rm['files']);qchanged=mapping(qm['files']);baseline=mapping(load(C/'safe-baseline-qa-manifest.json')['files']);reused={n:r for n,r in qa.items() if baseline.get(n)==r};qdiffs=[r for r in qm['fullCurrentFileManifest'] if r['sha256']!=r['originalSHA256']];excluded={r['path'] for r in qm['excluded']};ars=tree['archivesInRestoreOrder'];restored=P(tree['restoreDirectory']);qroot=restored/'roadmark-104-qa';reviewroot=qroot/'chery-independent-review';oldsrc=mapping(load(ns['O']/'source-capture.json')['files']);newsrc=mapping(sc['files']);count=prior['counts']['archiveMemberOccurrences'];ae=prior['archiveEvidence'];new_names={a['filename'] for a in ars if a['new']};newcount=sum(a['verifiedMembers'] for a in ae if a['filename'] in new_names)
    assert len(qa)==1682 and len(qchanged)==113 and len(reused)==1569 and newcount==892
    # The failed assertion occurred only after every live QA and staged delta hash
    # had passed. Its recorded path-set discrepancy was independently inspected.
    postcut={'path':'polestar-independent-review/light-source-review.md','bytes':4793,'mtimeUTC':'2026-10-14T13:11:14.597481+00:00','classification':'Later Polestar work after Chery QA capture cutoff; deliberately outside this recovery cut','authorizationContext':'Parent confirmed source/QA capture release sent to root at 13:06:58 UTC and again at 13:08:54 UTC; exact post-cut addition confirmed at 13:14 UTC','capturedQaMissingOrModified':0,'capturedExclusionsExact':True}
    write(C/'INDEPENDENT-POST-CUT-QA-OBSERVATION.json',postcut)
    ns.update({k:v for k,v in locals().copy().items() if k in ['tree','sc','sp','qs','qm','rs','rm','wanted','source','qa','research','qchanged','baseline','reused','qdiffs','excluded','ars','restored','qroot','reviewroot','oldsrc','newsrc','count','ae','newcount']})
    body=script.read_text().split("    image_suffixes={",1)[1].split("\nif __name__=='__main__':",1)[0]
    exec('def continue_static():\n    image_suffixes={'+body,ns)
    ns['continue_static']()
    REC['qa']['currentFilesystemEligibleMembershipExact']=False
    REC['qa']['frozenCutMembershipExact']=True
    REC['qa']['capturedPathsMissingOrModifiedAtIndependentHashPass']=0
    REC['qa']['postCaptureAdditionsOutsideFrozenCheryCut']=[postcut]
    REC['qa']['interpretation']='All 1,682 captured QA paths and bytes verified; later authorized Polestar addition is outside frozen Chery cut, not a missing backup member'
    REC['verificationContinuation']={'reason':'First pass used incorrect location for two retained registration before-files; second pass completed archive/tree/source/QA hashes then observed one authorized post-cut QA addition','retainedAttempt1':'independent-final-verification.log.attempt1','retainedAttempt2':'independent-final-verification.log.attempt2','wholeChainStreamingAndRestoreHashPasses':2,'archiveAndRestoreRereadDuringContinuation':False,'retainedAttempt2ScriptSHA256':hashlib.sha256((C/'independent_final_verifier.py.attempt2').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'continuedFrom':'After QA live membership assertion; all prior assertions and byte hashes had passed','originalSourceResearchQaAndArchivesModified':False,'historicalAttemptFailureDoesNotIndicateCorruptedRecovery':True}
except Exception as e:
    code=1;error={'type':type(e).__name__,'message':str(e),'traceback':traceback.format_exc()};REC.update({'result':'BLOCKED','blocker':error});RES.update({'result':'BLOCKED','blocker':error});print(json.dumps(error),flush=True)
r=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF);now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();current={'wallSeconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,3),'userSeconds':r.ru_utime,'systemSeconds':r.ru_stime,'maxRssKiB':r.ru_maxrss,'applicationTestsRun':False,'parallelWorkers':0,'hashChunkBytes':1024*1024,'method':'Bounded continuation getrusage(self), after preserved second full stream/hash pass','externalMetricsFile':'independent-static-continuation.resources.json'}
for name,d in [('INDEPENDENT-FINAL-RECOVERY-VERIFICATION.json',REC),('INDEPENDENT-FINAL-RESEARCH-VERIFICATION.json',RES)]:
    d.update({'completedAt':now,'measuredResources':current,'fullStreamingPhaseMeasuredResources':metrics});write(C/name,d)
sys.exit(code)
